liner.body_md:
## What listeners single out

- **Truckin'** (1 review): Reviewer loved the blast-off leading into Truckin' [8]
- **I Know You Rider** (1 other source): Outside the venue, a version of I Know You Rider played over the sound system, possibly a soundboard recording [2]
- **Playin' in the Band** (1 review): Reviewer singles out the closing part of Playin' as magnificent [7]

## Setlist highlights

- **Milestones**: back after 30 archived shows (370 days); rare: 14 archived performances [9]

## The recordings

- **deadco2024-07-05.Chas** (recommended): source not stated; 21 songs; 184 min; rated 5/5 by 2 [1]. Said about its sound: Audience can be heard in the background, which makes the recording feel more real [7]
- **deadco2024-07-05.Rainbowtoez.Shell**: source not stated; 22 songs; 193 min [2]
- **deadco2024-07-05.DREXELATLHEEL_Matrix**: matrix (soundboard mixed with audience mics); 22 songs; 183 min [3]
- **deadco2024-07-05.DREXELATLHEEL_External**: source not stated; 22 songs; 183 min [4]

## Around the show

- Stage talk about: Crowd 1st Set [1]
- Reviewer's first Sphere show; they also attended the following night, July 6th [8]
- Taped from Section 306 center, Row WC, Seat 16 [3]
- Taped from Section 306 center, Row WC, Seat 16 [4]

## Tapers and lineage

- **deadco2024-07-05.Chas**: taped by 21rooms1willdo; transferred by Hunter S; source: Zoom H5 Handheld onboard mics [1]. Also: Recorded on a Zoom H5 handheld with onboard mics; lineage SD > Wav > Reaper > Flac 24 [1]
- **deadco2024-07-05.Rainbowtoez.Shell**: taped by Rainbowtoez; transferred by Hunter S; source: 1 & 2: Church Audio CA-14 (omni) Bat2b custom modification > Stereo Breakout > Rode AI Micro > iPhone 14 Pro via Apogee Meta Recorder [2]
- **deadco2024-07-05.DREXELATLHEEL_Matrix**: taped by DREXELATLHEEL; transferred by Hunter S; source: Channel 1 & 2: SP-CMC-8u > SP-SPSB-10 > Sony PCM A10 Channel 3 & 4: Sony PCM A10 native mics [3]. Also: Matrix of two sources synced in Reaper: SP-CMC-8u external mics and Sony PCM A10 native mics; taper's first manual sync [3]
- **deadco2024-07-05.DREXELATLHEEL_External**: taped by DREXELATLHEEL; transferred by Hunter S; source: SP-CMC-8u > SP-SPSB-10 > Sony PCM A10 [4]. Also: SP-CMC-8u mics through SP-SPSB-10 into Sony PCM A10; SD > Audacity > Reaper (pan, EQ) > Flac 24 [4]
